Produces a dummy data set from a normal distribution and sample_info object.

Source: R/odds.R
dummy_data.Rd

Produces a dummy data set from a normal distribution and sample_info object.

Usage

dummy_data(
  group_min = 2,
  group_max = 20,
  dim_min = 1,
  dim_max = 50,
  param_min = 0,
  param_max = 20
)

Arguments

group_min

Minimum random number of groups. Defaults to 3

group_max

Maximum random number of groups. Defaults to 20. Note: group_max * dim max must be <= 1000

dim_min

Minimum random dimension of data frame. Defaults to 1

dim_max

Maximum random dimension of data frame. Defaults to 50. Note: group_max * dim max must be <= 1000

param_min

Minimum random parameters for normal distribution (i.e., mean and variance). Defaults to 0

param_max

Maximum random parameters for normal distribution. Defaults to 20

Value

A list, element one is the randomly generated data frame, element two is sample_info. Access with double brackets: [[1]], [[2]].
